description: Matrix-Centric Geospatial Playbooks - Strategic analysis patterns leveraging the Earth Matrix as infrastructure at every stage
key_insight: The Matrix is not just output - it's infrastructure. Use it to DEFINE vibes, FILTER candidates, CROSS-REFERENCE zones, and RANK results.

strategies.name: The Blank Street Protocol
strategies.context: Replicate the DNA of a chain's BEST-PERFORMING locations in a new market. User provides ONE Google Maps link to an existing location, we extract the chain's winning formula and find matching sites.

user_inputs.description: Link to ONE existing location of the chain (e.g., https://maps.google.com/?cid=...)
Where to search for new locations (city, neighborhood, or 'anywhere')

tools.purpose: Extract business name and website domain from Google Maps URL
Find ALL locations of the chain (source=google, PAID)
tools.note: Search by business name + domain to find all chain locations

tools.purpose: Extract DNA of best-performing locations (their hex + neighbors)
Get neighborhood context around each successful location
Check GDELT for relevant mentions in candidate areas
Find 'digital ghosts' (closed businesses) using 6+ month old review trick

reasoning_chain.description: Ask user for: (1) Google Maps link to ONE existing location, (2) Target area for expansion (optional)
reasoning_chain.agent_says: Please share a Google Maps link to one of your existing locations. Also, where are you looking to expand? (city/neighborhood, or say 'show me everywhere')

reasoning_chain.description: Extract business name and website domain from the Google Maps URL. This identifies the chain.
reasoning_chain.success_criteria: Have chain name and domain (e.g., 'Blank Street Coffee', 'blankstreet.com')

reasoning_chain.description: Use tool_search_entities(source=google, query=chain_name) to find ALL existing locations of this chain
reasoning_chain.success_criteria: List of all chain locations with ratings and review counts

reasoning_chain.description: Sort locations by: (1) rating, (2) number of reviews. Top performers = high rating + high review count
For each best performer, query Matrix for the hex + 5-ring neighborhood. Capture: score_transit, building_density, wealth_index, cafe_count, restaurant_count, has_commercial, etc.
reasoning_chain.success_criteria: DNA profile: the common attributes of successful locations

reasoning_chain.description: Create Matrix filter from the DNA (e.g., avg score_transit of winners ± 1, similar density range)
Query Matrix in target area (or everywhere if not specified) for hexes matching the DNA
reasoning_chain.if_area_unclear: Show all hits on map and ask user: 'I found X matching areas. Which region interests you?'
reasoning_chain.success_criteria: Candidate hexes that match the winning DNA

reasoning_chain.description: Use tool_fetch_news to check candidate areas for: new developments, foot traffic mentions, commercial activity, any red flags
reasoning_chain.success_criteria: News context for top candidate areas

reasoning_chain.description: Show results and ask user: 'I found these areas matching your DNA. Would you like to: (A) Dive deeper into any specific area, or (B) Check for available commercial spaces?'
reasoning_chain.agent_says: Here are areas that match your successful locations' DNA. Want me to (A) analyze any specific area deeper, or (B) find potentially available spaces?

reasoning_chain.description: Use the '6+ month old review' trick: search for businesses in candidate areas, filter for those whose most recent review is >6 months old - these may be closed/available
reasoning_chain.success_criteria: List of potentially available commercial spaces

reasoning_chain.description: Present the final list of spots: matching DNA, good news signals, potentially available spaces

dna_attributes.description: Matrix columns used to define a location's DNA

example_queries: I want to expand my coffee chain - here's a link to one of our best stores
Find locations like our successful Brooklyn store for expansion to LA
Where should we open our next location? [Google Maps link]
Replicate our winning formula in Chicago

strategies.name: The Vibe Neighborhood Finder
strategies.context: Finding neighborhoods matching a specific 'vibe' (clean beaches, hipster zones, family-friendly). Uses Matrix at every stage to define, filter, and rank.

tools.purpose: Define the 'vibe' using Matrix columns
Get base geometry (coastline, parks, etc.) if needed
Create travel-time polygon from key locations
Cross-reference travel zones with Matrix attributes
Calculate affluence/gentrification/vitality for ranking

reasoning_chain.description: Translate user's vibe into Matrix filters. Examples: 'clean beach' = score_coast > 8, bar_count < 2, building_density < 50; 'hipster' = cafe_count > 5, has_industrial = 1, gym_count > 0
Query Matrix to find hexes matching the vibe (e.g., beach hexes, park hexes)
Use tool_travel_time_zone to get polygon of area reachable in X minutes by chosen mode
Use tool_matrix_geometry to filter hexes INSIDE travel zone by desired attributes (e.g., wealth_index > 0.7)
Calculate affluence, gentrification, or vitality index for final ranking

clean_beach.description: Near beach, not nightlife heavy, not super dense

hipster_zone.description: Cafes, fitness culture, converted industrial areas

example_queries: Find affluent neighborhoods 20 mins by moped from clean beaches in Barcelona
Where are the hipster zones in Berlin?
Family-friendly areas within 15 min walk of parks in Amsterdam
Urban professional neighborhoods near transit in Tokyo

strategies.name: The Hedge Fund Sentinel
strategies.context: Analyzing soft commodities for supply disruptions. Maps production clusters, overlays weather risk, monitors live news.

tools.purpose: Map production clusters using MapSPAM data
Overlay weather risk data
Monitor live news for disruption signals
Analyze logistics corridors

reasoning_chain.description: Use tool_fetch_crops to identify major production regions
reasoning_chain.success_criteria: Production heatmap with top regions identified

reasoning_chain.description: Use tool_fetch_weather_risk to analyze drought, flood, frost risk in production zones
Use tool_fetch_news to check for: protest, flood, drought, strike near production zones
Map export routes and check for bottlenecks
Calculate total tonnage/value at risk

example_queries: What's the supply risk for cocoa from West Africa?
Assess coffee production vulnerability in Brazil
Monitor sugar supply chain disruptions

strategies.name: The Gentrification Hunter
strategies.context: Finding undervalued neighborhoods with gentrification potential. Uses Matrix to identify low-wealth areas with emerging affluence signals.

tools.purpose: Find low-wealth baseline areas
Check neighborhood for affluence signals
Calculate gentrification index
Find development signals in news

reasoning_chain.description: Query Matrix for areas with low wealth_index (< 0.4) - these are 'undervalued'
Use tool_neighborhood_query to find areas where surrounding hexes have: cafe_count > 3, gym_count > 0, has_industrial = 1 (converted spaces)
Use tool_calculate_index('gentrification') to score candidate areas
Check news for permits, construction, and development announcements
Gap = (Gentrification Index / Current Wealth) = Investment Opportunity

example_queries: Find gentrifying neighborhoods in Brooklyn
What areas in Austin are undervalued but improving?
Identify investment opportunities in up-and-coming Miami neighborhoods

strategies.name: The Quality of Life Scan
strategies.context: Finding pleasant places to live. Uses Matrix to filter for amenities, safety proxies, and lifestyle factors.

tools.purpose: Filter for amenities and lifestyle factors
Check climate comfort
Calculate vitality index for vibrancy
Get qualitative vibe from reviews (source=google, use sparingly)

reasoning_chain.description: Query Matrix for: score_park > 6, hospital_count > 0, supermarket_count > 0, score_transit > 5
Lower bar_count and higher residential density suggest family-friendly
Use tool_fetch_weather_risk to check heat, humidity, flood risk
Use tool_calculate_index('vitality') to ensure the area isn't dead
Only if user needs qualitative: scrape reviews of local cafes and parks

example_queries: What's the quality of life like in Lisbon for remote workers?
Find family-friendly neighborhoods in Tokyo
Best neighborhoods in Singapore for young professionals

strategies.name: The Coastal Lifestyle Finder
strategies.context: Finding the perfect coastal living spot. Demonstrates multi-stage Matrix usage: define beach quality, get coastline geometry, buffer it, cross-reference with lifestyle filters.

tools.purpose: Define 'clean beach' vibe with Matrix filters
Get coastline geometry for country
Create coastal buffer zone
Filter Matrix hexes within coastal buffer
Create travel-time polygon from beach spots
Rank by affluence or vitality

reasoning_chain.description: Use Matrix to find beach hexes that are NOT party zones: score_coast > 8, bar_count < 2, building_density < 50, has_park = 1
Use tool_fetch_geometry('coastline', country_code) to get coast shape
Use tool_buffer_geometry to create 2.5km coastal zone
Intersect clean beach hexes with coastal buffer
Use tool_travel_time_zone from best beaches (20 min moped)
Use tool_matrix_geometry on travel zone with wealth_index > 0.7, has_residential = 1
Use tool_calculate_index('vitality') or 'affluence' to rank

example_queries: Find affluent neighborhoods 20 mins by moped from clean beaches in Barcelona
Best coastal living spots near Lisbon that aren't party zones
Quiet beach neighborhoods within cycling distance in Valencia
Family-friendly coastal areas in the French Riviera

matrix_tools.description: Earth Matrix - Pre-computed H3 Feature Store (150+ columns). Use at EVERY stage.

tools.tool_matrix_geometry: Filter hexes by shape + attributes → Heatmap (Cookie Cutter)

geometry_tools.description: Cookie Cutter - Filter by ANY shape (coastlines, rivers, travel zones)

tools.tool_fetch_geometry: Get any geometry: coastline, river, park, road, railway, boundary
tools.tool_travel_time_zone: Approximate travel-time polygon (walking, cycling, moped, driving)

entity_tools.description: Entity Engine - Find specific objects (POIs, buildings)

tools.tool_search_entities: Unified search: source=athena (FREE), source=google (PAID), source=news, source=hdx
tools.tool_filter_by_geometry: Filter entities by shape (Cookie Cutter for entities)

signal_theory.description: What POI patterns reveal about an area - use this to CREATIVELY interpret any vibe
signal_theory.creative_interpretation: When a user asks for a novel vibe, THINK about what signals would indicate it. Build a custom filter. Explain your reasoning to the user.

clean_beach.description: Near beach, not nightlife heavy, not super dense
clean_beach.reasoning: Beach proximity but avoiding party zones (low bars) and crowded areas (low density)

hipster_zone.description: Cafes, fitness culture, converted industrial areas
hipster_zone.reasoning: Coffee culture + health-conscious + industrial conversion = classic gentrification pattern

tech_bro_paradise.description: Fitness-focused, cafes for remote work, urban transit, not party-heavy
tech_bro_paradise.reasoning: High income (gyms), productivity culture (cafes, moderate nightlife), urban connectivity

artist_colony.description: Affordable, cultural, industrial conversion, not touristy
artist_colony.reasoning: Artists need affordable rent + creative spaces + not overrun by tourists

retirement_haven.description: Healthcare access, green space, quiet, not dense
retirement_haven.reasoning: Elderly need medical access, green space for walks, peace and quiet

family_friendly.reasoning: Families need kid-friendly spaces (parks, schools) and avoid rowdy nightlife

urban_professional.reasoning: Young professionals want commute efficiency, social dining scene, health culture

retail_gravity.description: High foot traffic, transit access, existing retail
retail_gravity.reasoning: Retail needs footfall (transit), density (customers), and proven market (existing cafes)

gentrifying.description: Low wealth but emerging affluence signals
gentrifying.reasoning: Investment opportunity: currently affordable but showing signs of incoming affluent residents

livable.reasoning: The essentials for daily life: green space, medical access, mobility

student_zone.description: Nightlife, coffee, cheap food, not wealthy
student_zone.reasoning: Students need affordable living, social venues, late-night study spots

luxury_enclave.description: Very wealthy, hotels, dining, not crowded
luxury_enclave.reasoning: High-end residential: expensive, exclusive, service-rich but not dense

startup_hub.description: Coffee culture, commercial zoning, connected, converted spaces
startup_hub.reasoning: Startups cluster where there's cheap space (industrial), connectivity, and coffee meetings

usage_notes.matrix_first: Start with Matrix. It's instant, free, and shapes all downstream work.
usage_notes.entities_on_demand: Fetch entities only after Matrix has narrowed the search space.
usage_notes.live_for_validation: Reserve paid sources (google) for final validation of top candidates.
usage_notes.matrix_as_infrastructure: The Matrix is not output. It's infrastructure for every stage: define, filter, cross-reference, rank.
usage_notes.creative_interpretation: The vibe_dictionary contains reference patterns. The agent should synthesize novel combinations based on signal_theory principles.
usage_notes.show_reasoning: Explain the translation from user intent to signal combination. Trust is built through transparency.
